scenarios.name: test-gives-flying
scenarios.why: Generated by cmd/xmageport from XMage RuneOfFlightTest#testGivesFlying.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[equipment-granted-static-not-propagated]: Rune of Flight on Bonesplitter should give the equipped Grizzly Bears flying via the Aura's AddStaticAbility$ RuneFlightST ('Equipped creature has flying'); gorge grants no flying (lacks keyword), so the granted static is not propagated from the Aura to the Equipment's own static (rules.grantedStatics / layer 6), CR 613.1f, 301.5, verified at gorge 981b98963b.
